notes.0: the ladder leans against the haystack; a man walks in from the left
notes.4: he reaches the ladder and takes the left rail with his right hand
notes.6: right foot on the bottom rung
notes.8: first push: he steps up, left foot on the second rung
notes.16: halfway up, one rung at a time, hand then foot
notes.26: a push brings his head level with the top of the ladder
notes.32: the last push lifts him over the top of the ladder onto the haystack
notes.37: he is on the haystack above the ladder

no_cel: the SAM mask covers the man in most frames, so cel paint would erase the man and leave the ladder alone
